Overview

Quezon City is a city in Metro Manila with a population of 2,960,000. The Philippines’ most populous city, a sprawling urban center with universities, entertainment hubs, and a vibrant food scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
